meta.method: pyswisseph solcross_ut, Moshier ephemeris, geocentric apparent tropical Sun
meta.coverage: every Sun ingress from the Capricorn ingress of Dec 1919 (so 1-19 Jan 1920 maps) through Dec 2010
meta.how_to_use: For a birth date D: if D is in an ingress's cusp_local_dates, ask the reader which sign she reads (the sign before or the sign entered). Otherwise her sign is the sign of the latest ingress whose cusp_local_dates all fall before D.
meta.cusp_local_dates: every calendar date the ingress moment falls on somewhere on Earth (UT-12 to UT+14), since the page has no birth time or place
